title: SilverAIWolf Tutorial Config
description: Defines a complete guided tutorial with ordered stages, markdown content, and declarative server-side verification rules. One JSON file = one tutorial. An AI agent can generate a new tutorial by filling this schema.

name.description: Human-readable tutorial name shown in the UI.

description.description: One-paragraph summary of what the learner builds and what platform it targets.

tags.description: Searchable tags for the marketplace, e.g. ['databricks', 'lakebase', 'medallion'].

stages.description: Ordered list of tutorial stages — learner walks them one at a time.

Stage.description: A single stage in the tutorial. Stages are shown in order; each must be completed before the next unlocks.

phase.description: Phase grouping shown in the sidebar, e.g. 'Setup', 'Lakebase', 'Lakehouse', 'Analytics'.

label.description: Short label shown in the sidebar nav item.

icon.description: Single emoji shown next to the label.

title.description: Full page title shown in the content header, e.g. 'Landing Zone — Unity Catalog, schemas, and managed volume'.

special.description: If 'connect', renders the built-in workspace connection form instead of markdown content. Only used for the first stage.

items.description: 'table-browser': live Lakebase row explorer (seed stage). 'live-feed': real-time LISTEN/NOTIFY event stream (refresh stage).

widgets.description: Named interactive React widgets rendered after the markdown sections.

StageContent.description: Markdown content for a stage — callout box + one or more instructional sections.

sections.description: Ordered instructional sections. One section per major topic is typical.

Callout.description: Highlighted context box shown above the instructional sections.

icon.description: Single emoji for the callout, matching the stage icon.

body.description: Markdown body. Explain WHAT the learner is building and WHY — the conceptual context, not the steps. Use **bold** for key terms and `code` for identifiers. Newlines are \n in JSON.

Section.description: A titled instructional section with markdown body.

heading.description: Section heading, e.g. 'What to do in stage 02 — create the Unity Catalog landing zone'.

body.description: Markdown body — numbered lists, fenced code blocks (```bash, ```sql, ```), inline `code`, **bold**, *italic*, and tables are all supported. Newlines are \n in JSON. Indent code blocks inside list items with 3 spaces.

VerifyConfig.description: Server-side verification that runs when the learner clicks 'Verify'. All checks must pass.

SqlCheck.description: Run a SQL statement on the Databricks SQL warehouse (reads Delta tables, metric views, SHOW commands).

name.description: Check label shown in the verify panel.

statement.description: SQL to run — SELECT, SHOW, or DESCRIBE.

successTemplate.description: Detail shown on pass. Supports {count} and {found} placeholders.

errorHint.description: What the learner should do to fix a failing check.

PgCheck.description: Run a query on the Lakebase Postgres pool (pg_trigger, source tables, system catalogs).

query.description: SQL to run on the Postgres pool. Alias the count column as 'c' for count_gt checks.

PgEachCheck.description: Expand into one PG count check per table — use for the seed stage pattern where every table must be non-empty.

name_template.description: Check name with {table} placeholder, e.g. '{table} has rows'.

query_template.description: SQL with {table} placeholder, e.g. 'SELECT count(*)::int AS c FROM {table}'.

tables.description: List of table names to expand into individual checks.

PgOrRestCheck.description: Try the PG pool first (live proof); if pool is not ready, fall back to the REST list. Use for the provision stage where the pool may not yet be initialised.

pg_query.description: SQL to run on the PG pool, e.g. 'SELECT version()'.

rest_fn.description: REST helper to call if the PG check fails.

RestCheck.description: Call a named Databricks REST helper and find an item matching a regex.

successTemplate.description: Supports {field} placeholders from the matched item, e.g. '{display_name}'.

on_404.description: Custom error when the REST endpoint returns 404 (feature not enabled).

StateCheck.description: Assert an in-memory server state value. Currently only 'isListening' is supported.

key.description: True when the server holds an active LISTEN connection to Postgres.

RowsGte.description: Pass if the SQL/PG result set has at least n rows.

CountGt.description: Parse the first column of the first row as an integer; pass if > n. Use with SELECT count(*) queries.

AllInColumn.description: Pass if every expected value appears in the given column of the result set (0-indexed).

FindMatch.description: Pass if any item in the REST list has at least one of the given fields matching the pattern.

fields.description: Try each field in order, e.g. ['display_name'] or ['title', 'name'].
